spec.root_selector:
"${cut_cable}" as $cutval
| . as $graph
| ($graph.isolated_countries // []) as $baseline_isolated
| ($graph.cables[$cutval].edge_indices // [] | map({(tostring): true}) | add // {}) as $cutset
| [$graph.edges | to_entries[] | select(($cutset[(.key|tostring)] // false) | not) | .value] as $alive_edges
| (reduce $alive_edges[] as $e ({}; .[$e.from] += [$e.to] | .[$e.to] += [$e.from])) as $adj
| ([$graph.nodes | to_entries[]
     | select(.value.type=="country_hub")
     | select((.value.country) as $c | ($baseline_isolated | index($c)) == null)
   ][0].key) as $seed
| ( {visited: {($seed): true}, frontier: [$seed]}
    | until(.frontier == [];
        (.frontier | map($adj[.] // []) | add // []) as $cands
        | .visited as $v
        | ([$cands[] | select(($v[.] // false) | not)] | unique) as $new
        | .visited = ($v + ([$new[] | {(.): true}] | add // {}))
        | .frontier = $new
      )
    | .visited
  ) as $reached
| $graph.nodes | to_entries[]
    | select(.value.type=="country_hub")
    | select(($reached[.key] // false) | not)
    | select((.value.country) as $c | ($baseline_isolated | index($c)) == null)
    | { Country: .value.country, Hub_ID: .key }

spec.description: Countries that lose every path to the main component after this cable cut. Countries already isolated at baseline (Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Tuvalu) are excluded, since they are isolated regardless of the scenario.
spec.title: Total outage after cutting: $cut_cable

spec.root_selector:
"${historical_event}" as $eid
| . as $graph
| (
    if $eid == "" then
      [{ Row: "Pick an event above", Details: "" }]
    else
      ($graph.historical_events[] | select(.id == $eid)) as $ev
      | [
          { Row: "Event", Details: ($ev.name + " (" + $ev.date + ")") },
          { Row: "Cables cut", Details: ($ev.cables | join(", ")) },
          { Row: "Cause", Details: $ev.cause },
          { Row: "Real impact (reported)", Details: $ev.real_impact },
          { Row: "Model prediction (today's topology)", Details: (if ($ev.model_predicted_isolated_countries | length) == 0 then "No countries fully isolated" else ($ev.model_predicted_isolated_countries | join(", ")) + " fully isolated" end) },
          { Row: "Source", Details: $ev.source }
        ] + (if $ev.note then [{ Row: "Note", Details: $ev.note }] else [] end)
    end
  ) as $rows
| $rows[]

spec.description: Cuts the real cable set from a real historical incident against todays topology and compares the models predicted isolated countries to what was actually reported. Three real events: Red Sea (Feb 2024), West Africa (Mar 2024), Tonga (Jan 2022).
spec.title: Show me the math: historical event validation

spec.root_selector:
"${cut_cable}" as $cutval
| . as $graph
| ($graph.reroute_pressure[$cutval] // []) as $entries
| if $cutval == "" then
    [{ Edge: "(no cut)", Baseline_Load: null, New_Load: null, Pressure: "" }]
  elif ($entries | length) == 0 then
    [{ Edge: "(none)", Baseline_Load: null, New_Load: null, Pressure: "This cut has no baseline shortest paths to reroute, or every affected pair became fully unreachable instead." }]
  else
    [ $entries[]
      | . as $e
      | ($graph.edges[$e.edge]) as $edge
      | {
          Edge: (if $edge.type == "submarine" then
                   ($graph.cables[$edge.cable_id].name // $edge.cable_id) + ": " + $graph.nodes[$edge.from].country + " <-> " + $graph.nodes[$edge.to].country
                 else
                   "Terrestrial: " + $edge.from + " <-> " + $edge.to
                 end),
          Baseline_Load: $e.baseline_load,
          New_Load: $e.new_load,
          Pressure: (if $e.ratio == null then "new (previously unused)" else (($e.ratio|tostring) + "x") end)
        }
    ]
  end
| .[]

spec.description: Stage 3: for baseline pairs whose shortest path used $cut_cable, the surviving edges that pick up extra load after rerouting -- unitless and relative to the edge's normal baseline_pair_path_count share, capped to the top 8 by ratio. No fabricated capacity numbers.
spec.title: Reroute pressure after cutting: $cut_cable

spec.root_selector:
"${cut_cable}" as $cutval
| . as $graph
| if $cutval == "" then
    { Cable: "(no cut)", Landing_Points: 0, Affected_Countries: "" }
  else
    ($graph.cables[$cutval]) as $cable
    | ($cable.landing_point_ids // []) as $lps
    | ([$lps[] as $lp | $graph.nodes[$lp].country] | unique | sort) as $countries
    | { Cable: $cable.name, Landing_Points: ($lps | length), Affected_Countries: ($countries | join(", ")) }
  end

spec.root_selector:
"${cut_cable}" as $cutval
| . as $graph
| ($graph.nodes | to_entries | map(select(.value.type=="country_hub")) | length) as $total_hubs
| ($graph.isolated_countries // []) as $baseline_isolated
| ($total_hubs - ($baseline_isolated | length)) as $baseline_reachable
| (
    if $cutval == "" then $baseline_reachable
    else
      ($graph.cables[$cutval].edge_indices // [] | map({(tostring): true}) | add // {}) as $cutset
      | [$graph.edges | to_entries[] | select(($cutset[(.key|tostring)] // false) | not) | .value] as $alive_edges
      | (reduce $alive_edges[] as $e ({}; .[$e.from] += [$e.to] | .[$e.to] += [$e.from])) as $adj
      | ([$graph.nodes | to_entries[]
           | select(.value.type=="country_hub")
           | select((.value.country) as $c | ($baseline_isolated | index($c)) == null)
         ][0].key) as $seed
      | ( {visited: {($seed): true}, frontier: [$seed]}
          | until(.frontier == [];
              (.frontier | map($adj[.] // []) | add // []) as $cands
              | .visited as $v
              | ([$cands[] | select(($v[.] // false) | not)] | unique) as $new
              | .visited = ($v + ([$new[] | {(.): true}] | add // {}))
              | .frontier = $new
            )
          | .visited
        ) as $reached
      | [$graph.nodes | to_entries[]
           | select(.value.type=="country_hub")
           | select((.value.country) as $c | ($baseline_isolated | index($c)) == null)
           | select($reached[.key] // false)
        ] | length
    end
  ) as $after_reachable
| [
    { State: "Baseline (main)", Reachable_Hubs: $baseline_reachable },
    { State: (if $cutval == "" then "After cut (none)" else "After cutting: " + $cutval end), Reachable_Hubs: $after_reachable }
  ] | .[]

spec.description: All 2307 submarine cable edges (great-circle endpoints) rendered as arcs on the globe. The selected cable ($cut_cable) is highlighted in red with a flow effect; surviving edges that pick up rerouted load (Stage 3) are highlighted orange/yellow, scaled by pressure severity.
spec.title: Globe: cable network

spec.root_selector:
"${from_country}" as $from
| "${to_country}" as $to
| "${cut_cable}" as $cutval
| . as $graph
| (
    if $from == "" or $to == "" then
      [{ State: "Pick two countries", Latency_ms: null, Note: "Choose From and To above." }]
    elif $from == $to then
      [{ State: "Same country", Latency_ms: 0, Note: "" }]
    else
      ([$from, $to] | sort | join("|")) as $key
      | ($graph.latency_baseline[$key]) as $entry
      | if $entry == null then
          [{ State: "No path", Latency_ms: null, Note: "One or both endpoints are isolated from the main network at baseline." }]
        else
          $entry[0] as $baseline_ms
          | $entry[1] as $cable_idxs
          | ($graph.latency_cable_index | index($cutval)) as $cut_idx
          | (($cutval != "") and ($cut_idx != null) and (($cable_idxs | index($cut_idx)) != null)) as $affected
          | [
              { State: "Baseline (main)", Latency_ms: $baseline_ms, Note: "" }
            ] + (
              if $cutval == "" then []
              elif $affected then
                [{ State: ("After cutting: " + $cutval), Latency_ms: null, Note: "This cable carries part of the baseline shortest path -- a reroute exists, but its exact latency is not modeled live." }]
              else
                [{ State: ("After cutting: " + $cutval), Latency_ms: $baseline_ms, Note: "Unaffected: this cable is not on the shortest baseline path between these two countries." }]
              end
            )
        end
    end
  ) as $rows
| $rows[]

spec.description: Precomputed shortest-path latency (Stage 2) between $from_country and $to_country. If the cut cable actually carries part of the baseline path, the exact rerouted latency is not modeled live (build-time precomputation only covers the uncut baseline) -- shown honestly rather than guessed.
spec.title: Latency: $from_country <-> $to_country

spec.description: Real measured RTT (RIPE Atlas anchor mesh, live network measurement) against the modelled physics-only latency_baseline, for 17 curated country pairs across 16 countries with an active RIPE Atlas anchor. Measured is always higher than modelled -- the model is an honest lower bound, not a claimed prediction (real routing is never a straight fiber line).
spec.title: Show me the math: modelled vs. measured (RIPE Atlas)

spec.root_selector:
[.atlas_validation[].ratio] | sort as $s | ($s|length) as $n
| { Median_Ratio: (if $n % 2 == 1 then $s[($n-1)/2] else (($s[$n/2 - 1] + $s[$n/2]) / 2 | . * 100 | round / 100) end), Pairs_Checked: $n }

spec.description: Median of measured/modelled ratio across all checked RIPE Atlas pairs -- how much real-world routing typically adds on top of the physics-only lower bound.
spec.title: Median real-world overhead
